trail.name: Hermitage Point
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Colter Bay Trailhead marker, 43.8-71.6 m from the two reviewed USGS route endpoints in the Colter Bay access area. This single trailhead-area forecast cannot represent every exposure along the 9.5-mile loop.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS route-map configuration distinguishes the full Hermitage Point loop from the shorter Heron Pond-Swan Lake route.

comparison.note: Nine connected NPS-origin USGS segments total about 9.692 miles for the full Hermitage Point loop, 2.0% above the NPS 9.5-mile value. The shorter pond connector is excluded, as is short unmeasured access inside the Colter Bay parking area.

photo.alt: Yellow wildflowers stand in sharp focus beside Jackson Lake with the Teton Range beyond.
photo.permissionNote: The official activity page credits A. Falgoust for NPS and displays no third-party restriction. Retain the credit and source link; no endorsement is implied. The distant mountains are intentionally soft while the foreground flowers remain sharp.
